notes: Provenance registry. Every artifact served by Copernico traces back to one entry here. 'expect' fields are asserted by scripts/geospatial before any processing. Research evidence: docs/research/datasets-terrain.md and docs/research/rover-environment-time.md.

datasets.title: Mars 2020 TRN HiRISE DTM mosaic (1 m)
datasets.crs: Equirectangular, lat_ts 0, lon_0 0, sphere R = 3396190 m (≡ IAU_2015:49910)
datasets.uncertainty: Vertical precision ~0.2 m (HiRISE DTM, Kirk et al. 2008); median −0.4 m vs CTX DTM; HiRISE co-registration < 3 m (P99). The 'CR' crater-rim stereo model has documented quality problems.
datasets.license: US Government work / no use constraints (USGS); please cite
datasets.citation: Fergason, R.L. et al. (2020) Mars 2020 Terrain Relative Navigation Flight Product Generation. LPSC 51, #2020.

datasets.title: Mars 2020 TRN HiRISE orthomosaic (25 cm)
datasets.crs: Equirectangular, lat_ts 0, lon_0 0, sphere R = 3396190 m
datasets.uncertainty: Orthorectified on the TRN DTM; served at 0.5 m in Copernico. Image resolution ≠ elevation resolution.
datasets.license: US Government work / no use constraints (USGS); please cite

datasets.title: Mars 2020 Science Investigation CTX DEM (20 m)
datasets.crs: Equirectangular, lat_ts 18.4663, lon_0 0, sphere R = 3396190 m (verified from the GeoTIFF header 2026-09-25; the Astropedia page's 3396160 m is incorrect)
datasets.uncertainty: 'Accurate to control net'. Used for crater-scale context terrain only, never for routing.
datasets.license: US Government work; cite Mangold et al. 2021
datasets.citation: Mangold, N. et al. (2021) Perseverance rover reveals an ancient delta-lake system and flood deposits at Jezero crater, Mars. Science 374, 711–717.

datasets.title: Mars 2020 Science Investigation CTX orthomosaic (5 m)
datasets.license: US Government work; cite Mangold et al. 2021

datasets.title: MOLA Mission Experiment Gridded Data Record, 32 pixels/degree topography
datasets.uncertainty: ~1.85 km grid; vertical accuracy of MOLA tracks ~1 m, gridding error dominates at this scale.
datasets.citation: Smith, D.E. et al. (2003) MGS MOLA MEGDR, MGS-M-MOLA-5-MEGDR-L3-V1.0, NASA PDS.

datasets.title: Viking Orbiter colorized global mosaic (925 m)
datasets.published: UNVERIFIED (to be read from file metadata)
datasets.crs: Simple cylindrical on the Mars sphere (to be confirmed from the file)
datasets.uncertainty: Colorized mosaic for visual context; horizontal accuracy ~200–300 m (MDIM 2.1). Colors are enhanced, not true color.
datasets.citation: USGS Astrogeology, Viking MDIM 2.1 / colorized global mosaic.

datasets.title: THEMIS-derived thermal inertia of Jezero Crater
datasets.crs: Simple cylindrical, lon_0 0, sphere R = 3396190 m
datasets.uncertainty: Derived product; ~100 m resolution, much coarser than the routing grid. Used as a soft penalty flag only.
datasets.citation: Edwards, C.S. & Buz, J. (2021) THEMIS-derived Thermal Inertia of Jezero Crater, Mars. Zenodo. doi:10.5281/zenodo.4931348

datasets.title: CRISM map-projected targeted reduced data records (MTRDR): summary-parameter browse composites
datasets.productId: mrocr_4001: HRL000040FF, FRT000047A3, FRT00005850, FRT00005C5E, FRT000066A4, FRT0001FB74 (BRCARJ, BRMAFJ)
datasets.publisher: NASA PDS Geosciences Node (JHU/APL CRISM team)
datasets.units: Byte-scaled RGB composites of spectral summary parameters (band depths and indices; unitless)
datasets.crs: Equirectangular, planetocentric, east longitude, sphere R = 3394.8398 km, standard parallel 15°: rows and columns are lines of latitude and longitude
datasets.uncertainty: Summary parameters indicate, but do not identify, minerals; confirmation needs spectra. Georeferencing from MRO pointing: offsets of one to a few CRISM pixels (18–36 m) relative to the HiRISE TRN mosaic are possible. Observations from 2007 and 2011; dust and illumination differ between them.
datasets.citation: Seelos, F.P. et al. (2016) CRISM MTRDR, MRO-M-CRISM-5-RDR-MPTARGETED-V1.0, NASA PDS. Composites after Viviano-Beck, C.E. et al. (2014) JGR Planets 119, 1403–1431, doi:10.1002/2014JE004627.

datasets.title: Mars 2020 rover waypoints, traverse, samples and Ingenuity flights (MMGIS)
datasets.published: continuously updated; snapshot date recorded per build
datasets.units: planetocentric °N / °E; easting/northing in the Mars 2020 frame (eqc lat_ts 18.4663)
datasets.crs: Mars 2020 frame; the files' 'CRS84' declaration is an Earth placeholder and is ignored
datasets.uncertainty: Tactical localizations, ~10 sols latency. Known data bug: Lefroy Bay lat/lon duplicated from Pelican Point (easting/northing used instead).
datasets.license: NASA media/data usage guidelines (terms UNVERIFIED); cite NASA/JPL-Caltech

datasets.title: Mars 2020 PLACES localizations (best tactical)
datasets.crs: Mars 2020 frame (eqc lat_ts 18.4663, R 3396190 m) — verified to < 1 cm by unit tests
datasets.uncertainty: Archival localizations (~2 months latency). The planetodetic_latitude column is constant and unused.
datasets.citation: Mars 2020 PLACES bundle, NASA PDS Geosciences Node.

datasets.title: Mars 2020 MEDA calibrated air temperature (ATS) and derived pressure (PS)
datasets.productId: mars2020_meda: data_calibrated_env CAL_ATS, data_derived_env DER_PS, DER_ANCILLARY
datasets.crs: Point measurements at the rover position (MMGIS waypoint for the sol)
datasets.uncertainty: ATS values are local temperatures near the mast and may include rover thermal influence; the median of ATS 1–3 is used per sample. Pressure depends on elevation, which changed by ~640 m along the traverse. Releases lag observations by ~3–4 months.
datasets.license: NASA PDS (public); cite the MEDA archive
datasets.citation: Rodriguez-Manfredi, J.A. et al., Mars 2020 MEDA bundle, NASA PDS Atmospheres Node.

datasets.title: Yale Bright Star Catalog, 5th Revised Edition (J2000)
datasets.crs: ICRF/J2000; proper motion applied to epoch 2026.75
datasets.uncertainty: Catalog positions (arcsecond level); stars with V ≤ 6.5 (8,404). Colours approximated from spectral class.
datasets.license: Public astronomical catalog; cite Hoffleit & Warren (1991)
datasets.citation: Hoffleit, D. & Warren, W.H. Jr. (1991) The Bright Star Catalogue, 5th Revised Ed.

datasets.title: Deep Star Maps 2020: Milky Way background (celestial, 4K)
datasets.crs: ICRF plate carrée, RA 0h at centre increasing leftward
datasets.uncertainty: Visualization product; asinh display stretch (not photometric).
datasets.license: NASA SVS media (credit required); Gaia DR2 data ESA/Gaia/DPAC (CC BY-SA 3.0 IGO)
datasets.citation: NASA/Goddard Space Flight Center Scientific Visualization Studio. Gaia DR2: ESA/Gaia/DPAC.
